description: A shared layer 7 proxy between applications and model providers that authenticates callers, meters tokens, routes, falls back, streams, caches and records every request.
A per-tenant limit measured in tokens, usually a token bucket: the gateway reserves input plus maximum output tokens before a call and reconciles with the reported usage after it.
A name such as `support-chat` that the gateway maps to a concrete model by capability, cost and latency, so swapping the model is a configuration change.
Moving a request to the next provider only on retryable errors (`429`, `5xx`, timeouts), with a circuit breaker per provider, and never after the first streamed chunk.
Reuses an answer only for an identical request, keyed by a hash of tenant, model, parameters, system prompt, tool definitions and messages.
Embeds the prompt and returns the stored answer of the most similar earlier prompt when its similarity reaches a threshold.
The exact partition a semantic lookup may search: tenant, model, system prompt, tool definitions and sampling parameters, so answers never cross tenants or instructions.
A semantic cache hit for a prompt that only looks similar, which serves a confident answer to a different question; a higher threshold gives fewer false hits and fewer hits.
